content:
Here’s a fact that’s so mundane it might make your eyes glaze over:

**The average office worker uses about 10,000 sheets of paper per year, which is roughly equivalent to the height of a two-story building if stacked vertically.**

(And yes, most of it ends up in recycling bins or shredders within weeks.)
